name: qa-golden-v1
description: FROZEN QA regression baseline. Each case is scored by an internal/eval deterministic CodeJudge (keyword presence or JSON-validity) on the keyless path — zero model calls, zero network. expected_score is the frozen value the pre-push golden gate asserts; any drift fails the push. Do NOT edit expected_score to make a failing run pass — a change here is a deliberate baseline update.

cases.name: keyword-hit
cases.query: What is the capital of France?
cases.response: The capital of France is Paris.

cases.name: keyword-miss
cases.query: What is the capital of France?
cases.response: I am not certain about that.

cases.name: json-valid
cases.query: Answer strictly as a JSON object.
